testcase.name: Scenario: Open and dismiss the file menu in a drawing: tmp/obk-file-menu-receipt-b13d/features/application/file-menu/file-menu.feature:29:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Open and dismiss the file menu in a drawing ✔ Given a drawing document is active in the MCAD Software ✔ When the user selects File ✔ Then the menu shows New, Open, Save, Save As, Export, Share, Manage, document properties, Print and Close entries ✔ And a recent-documents region is visible ✔ And the drawing sheet remains visible around the menu ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the File menu closes ✔ And the same drawing document remains active
